arguments.sql:
SELECT t.language, COUNT(*) AS entries, COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM(t.translation), '')) AS named_entries,
       MIN(s.releaseDate) AS first_release, COUNT(s.totalSetSize) AS entries_with_set_size
FROM main.set_translations AS t
JOIN main.sets AS s ON s.code = t.setCode
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01' AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY t.language

JOIN main.sets AS s ON s.code = t.setCode
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01' AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY t.language

arguments.sql:
SELECT SUM(s.totalSetSize) AS total_cards
FROM main.sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
  AND s.code IN (
      SELECT t.setCode
      FROM main.set_translations AS t
      WHERE t.language <> 'English'
        AND TRIM(t.language) <> ''
        AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
  )
LIMIT 1
